name: cockpit
description: One band above the prompt: quick replies, branch/PR/CI standing, decision cards, waiting-on-you items, standing-rule capture and a Hand off chip at natural breaks.

replyGo.title: Go reply
replyGo.description: What the Go button sends as your own words (no hotkey: press the button).

replyResume.title: Resume reply
replyResume.description: What the Resume button sends as your own words (no hotkey: press the button).
replyResume.default: Resume from where you left off; do not restart from scratch.

replyTryAgain.title: Try again reply
replyTryAgain.description: What the Try again button (hotkey t) sends as your own words.

replyStatus.title: Status reply
replyStatus.description: What the Status button (hotkey s) sends as your own words.
replyStatus.default: Status update: what ran and passed, what is merged, what is pending, and the link where it can be seen.

replyCompletion.title: Session completion reply
replyCompletion.description: What the Session completion button sends as your own words (no hotkey: press the button).
replyCompletion.default: Is everything done, completed and merged on green CI in this session, and communicated back to the lead session if there is one? If so, archive this session to wrap up; or is that already done?

handoffTokens.title: Offer Hand off at (tokens)
handoffTokens.description: The band offers Hand off (the handoff mod's /handoff) once the context passes this many tokens with the session idle (default 150000, the point where cost, latency and quality start to suffer whatever the window; 20000 to 1000000). 0 falls back to 80 % of the window.
